failures.summary: The generated Vitest pin does not satisfy the Angular build peer range.
Nx cannot evaluate the generated TypeScript ESLint flat configuration because typescript-eslint is not installed.
The revalidation command was invoked from the repository root rather than the generated workspace.
failures.relevant_error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open modernization/modernization/package.json

failures.summary: The generated TypeScript configuration uses a removed-next-version option and two strict boolean signal inputs receive string attributes.
failures.relevant_error: TS5101 baseUrl is deprecated; TS2322 Type string is not assignable to boolean for currency

failures.summary: After baseUrl removal, TypeScript 6 requires path mapping targets to be explicitly relative.
failures.relevant_error: TS5090: Non-relative paths are not allowed when baseUrl is not set

failures.summary: Angular's non-browser unit-test runner has no installed DOM implementation.
failures.relevant_error: A DOM environment is required for non-browser tests. Please install either jsdom or happy-dom.

failures.summary: The Angular unit-test executor requests a development build configuration that the generated application target does not define.
failures.relevant_error: Configuration 'development' for target 'build' in project 'healthclinic-web' is not set in the workspace.

evidence: modernized/package.json pins vitest 3.2.4
npm registry metadata for @angular/build 22.1.4 declares optional peer vitest ^4.0.8
npm install failed with ERESOLVE before creating node_modules or package-lock.json

candidate_repairs.repair: Upgrade only Vitest to a compatible 4.x release

diagnoses.rationale: Vitest 4.1.11 satisfies ^4.0.8 while preserving Angular 22, Nx, and the generated unit-test strategy with a one-file metadata change.

evidence: The generated eslint.config.mjs imports nx.configs.flat.typescript
The installed Nx preset requires the typescript-eslint module at evaluation time
typescript-eslint 8.69.0 supports ESLint 9 and TypeScript versions below 6.1

candidate_repairs.repair: Remove the generated TypeScript ESLint preset

diagnoses.selected_repair: Add typescript-eslint 8.69.0 as a development dependency
diagnoses.rationale: This supplies the package required by the selected Nx flat config without weakening module-boundary lint configuration.

evidence: The error path points to the repository root package.json
The generated package.json exists under modernized/
No dependency resolution was attempted

candidate_repairs.repair: Re-run npm install with modernized/ as the explicit working directory

diagnoses.rationale: The failure is operational and requires no source or dependency change.

evidence: TypeScript 6.0 emits TS5101 for compilerOptions.baseUrl
Path aliases do not require baseUrl in this workspace
Angular strict template diagnostics identify both bare currency attributes as strings
SummaryCardComponent declares currency with input(false), producing a boolean input

candidate_repairs.repair: Remove baseUrl and use explicit boolean property bindings
Suppress TypeScript deprecations and weaken strict templates

diagnoses.selected_repair: Remove baseUrl and replace both currency attributes with [currency]=true
diagnoses.rationale: This directly corrects the obsolete option and template types without changing architecture or behavior.

evidence: TS5090 identifies all five non-relative path targets
The compiler explicitly requests a leading ./
Angular bundle resolution failures correspond to those aliases

candidate_repairs.repair: Restore baseUrl and suppress its deprecation

diagnoses.selected_repair: Prefix all five TypeScript path targets with ./
diagnoses.rationale: This completes the TypeScript 6 migration without suppressing diagnostics or changing module boundaries.

evidence: The Angular test executor explicitly reports that jsdom or happy-dom is required
No DOM implementation exists in package.json or the installed top-level dependency tree
jsdom 30.0.1 supports the installed Node 22.23.2 runtime

candidate_repairs.repair: Add jsdom 30.0.1 as a development dependency

diagnoses.selected_repair: Add jsdom 30.0.1 as a development dependency
diagnoses.rationale: This enables the generated Angular component tests without deleting or weakening them and is the fifth implementation repair iteration.

evidence: The healthclinic-web test executor loads healthclinic-web:build:development
The generated build target has options but no configurations object
The failure occurs before test discovery or assertion execution

candidate_repairs.repair: Add a standards-aligned development build configuration to healthclinic-web

diagnoses.rationale: The likely repair is clear, but Prompt 064 limits automatic implementation repairs to five and that limit has been reached.

repairs.description: Upgraded Vitest from 3.2.4 to 4.1.11 and generated the npm lockfile.
Added typescript-eslint 8.69.0 for the selected Nx TypeScript flat configuration.
Removed deprecated baseUrl and made currency signal-input bindings explicitly boolean.
Made all five TypeScript path targets explicitly relative after baseUrl removal.
Added jsdom 30.0.1 as the Angular non-browser unit-test DOM environment.
